image.name: intellij-idea
image.description: [IntelliJ IDEA](https://www.jetbrains.com/idea/) helps you write code faster with tools that eliminate tedious tasks and let you focus on what matters – building great software.

changelog.desc: Install intellij-idea-oss, Arch's new name for the community edition package.
Remove aarch64 support as it has been dropped upstream.
Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Change aarch64 version to best effort.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: IntelliJ IDEA desktop gui HTTP must be proxied.

image.title: Intellij-idea
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  intellij-idea:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/intellij-idea:latest
    container_name: intellij-idea
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=intellij-idea \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/intellij-idea:latest
